decisions.decision: Use OpenAI credentials only for workflow validation.

decisions.decision: Submit three pi-dynamic-workflows PRs instead of one combined PR.
decisions.rationale: The upstream contributor guide requires one concern per PR. Delivery, runtime compatibility, and status rendering are independent defects.

decisions.decision: Keep the combined integration branch local and test patch-identical cherry-picks of the three PR commits.
decisions.rationale: The upstream PRs must stay isolated, while the local combined build verifies their interaction before merge.

decisions.decision: Do not change pi-claude-marketplace production code for the engine defects.
decisions.rationale: The root causes and fix sites are in pi-dynamic-workflows. The marketplace bridge already installed and invoked the saved workflow correctly.
